source_citation: Diggs, Lipscomb & O'Kennon (1999), Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas

morphology_source_reported.growth_habit: Low annual; prostrate to erect; freely branched
morphology_source_reported.pubescence: Stem hairs retrorse (genus key), becoming nearly glabrous in age
morphology_source_reported.leaves: Palmately trifoliolate (genus description), leaflet margins usually conspicuously spreading-ciliate
morphology_source_reported.flowers: Rose-violet standard, white wings and keel, keel often purple-tipped
morphology_source_reported.fruit_calyx_cover: Calyx covers half to three quarters of mature fruit
morphology_source_reported.diagnostic_characters: Retrorse stem hairs vs. antrorse hairs in K. stipulacea

habitat_source_reported: Naturalized sandy roadsides, pastures and open woods
cautions: Source documents introduction from China and Japan; not a native-plant endorsement
